description: Zero slippage parameters in DEX liquidity operations enable MEV sandwich attacks that extract value from the protocol

poc_level_descriptors.L3A: public withdrawal/rebalance entrypoint called with sandwich position
poc_level_descriptors.L3B: tick/price manipulation shown; strategy receives fewer tokens than fair share
poc_level_descriptors.L3C: full sandwich: front-run + strategy call + back-run; attacker profit and strategy loss quantified

high_severity_rationale: High requires proving attacker profit from sandwich and direct balance decrease. Medium is supported by showing the zero-slippage code path exists and the attack vector is viable.
negative_control_template: Apply 1% slippage tolerance (amount0Min = expected * 99/100). Assert the call reverts when pool is manipulated. Assert strategy receives expected token amounts with protection.
